description:

A Rejuvenate dull, damaged tresses with a hydrating Episilk formula infused with Hyaluronic Acid to give you rich hair from the scalp to the roots. This nourishing conditioner gives instant hydration, giving you that sleek, silky smooth hair that you’ll be proud to wear every day.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use Episilk™ Conditioner with my other hair care products?

Yes. Episilk™ Conditioner can be used with any other hair products and works especially well when used prior to using Episilk™ Shampoo.

What can Hyaluronic Acid do for my hair and scalp?

Structurally the scalp is identical to the skin tissue located throughout the body except it also contains about 100,000 hair follicles that give rise to hair. The hair and hair follicles are a derivative of skin tissue. There are two distinctive skin layers, one, the epidermis (outer layer) which gives rise to the protective shield of the body and the other, the dermal layer (deep layer) which makes up the bulk of the skin and is where the hair follicle is located.

This dermal layer is composed of connective tissue and the connective tissue, with its gelatinous fluid like characteristics provides support, nourishes and hydrates the deep layers of the scalp. The result is healthy lustrous hair and a moisturized scalp. Again, all of this is made possible because of the presence of HA in the scalp tissue and its ability to form this fluid and hold water.

Preguntas frecuentes

¿Puedo usar Episilk™ Conditioner con mis otros productos para el cuidado del cabello?

Sí. El acondicionador Episilk™ se puede utilizar con cualquier otro producto para el cabello y funciona especialmente bien cuando se usa antes de usar Episilk™ Shampoo.

¿Qué puede hacer el ácido hialurónico para mi cabello y cuero cabelludo?

Estructuralmente el cuero cabelludo es idéntico al tejido de la piel ubicado en todo el cuerpo, excepto que también contiene alrededor de 100.000 folículos pilosos que dan lugar al cabello. Los folículos pilosos y pilosos son un derivado del tejido de la piel. Hay dos capas distintivas de la piel, una, la epidermis (capa externa) que da lugar al escudo protector del cuerpo y la otra, la capa dérmica (capa profunda) que compone la mayor parte de la piel y es donde se encuentra el folículo piloso.

Esta capa dérmica está compuesta por tejido conectivo y tejido conectivo, con sus características similares al líquido gelatinoso proporciona soporte, nutre e hidrata las capas profundas del cuero cabelludo. El resultado es un cabello brillante saludable y un cuero cabelludo hidratado. Una vez más, todo esto es posible debido a la presencia de HA en el tejido del cuero cabelludo y su capacidad para formar este líquido y retener el agua.

Spendet Feuchtigkeit und spendet Feuchtigkeit für ein weiches, gesund aussehendes Haar.

Dieser pflegende Conditioner spendet sofortige Feuchtigkeit und gibt Ihnen das glatte, seidig glatte Haar, das Sie jeden Tag tragen werden.

Häufig gestellte Fragen:

Kann ich Episilk™ Conditioner mit meinen anderen Haarpflegeprodukten verwenden?

Ja Episilk™ Conditioner kann mit allen anderen Haarprodukten verwendet werden und funktioniert besonders gut, wenn es vor der Verwendung von Episilk™ Shampoo verwendet wird.

Was kann Hyaluronsäure für meine Haare und Kopfhaut tun?

Strukturell ist die Kopfhaut identisch mit dem Hautgewebe, das sich im ganzen Körper befindet, außer sie enthält auch etwa 100.000 Haarfollikel, die dem Haar entstehen, Die Haar- und Haarfollikel sind ein Derivat des Hautgewebes. Es gibt zwei unverwechselbare Hautschichten, eine Epidermis (äußere Schicht), die den schützenden Schutz des Körpers hervorrufen und die andere, die dermale Schicht (tiefe Schicht), die den Großteil der Haut ausmacht und sich dort befindet, wo sich die Haarfollikel befindet.

Diese Hautschicht besteht aus Bindegewebe und Bindegewebe, mit ihren gelatinösen flüssigen Eigenschaften bietet Unterstützung, pflegt und hydratisiert die tiefen Schichten der Kopfhaut. Das Ergebnis ist gesundes glänzendes Haar und eine feuchtigkeitsspendende Kopfhaut. All dies wird durch das Vorhandensein von HA im Kopfhautgewebe und seine Fähigkeit, diese Flüssigkeit zu bilden und Wasser zu speichern.

Perguntas frequentes

Posso usar o condicionador Episilk™ com meus outros produtos de cuidados com o cabelo?

Sim. O condicionador Episilk™ pode ser usado com qualquer outro produto de cabelo e funciona especialmente bem quando usado antes de usar o xampu Episilk™.

O que o ácido hialurônico pode fazer pelo meu cabelo e couro cabeludo.

Estruturalmente, o couro cabeludo é idêntico ao tecido da pele localizado em todo o corpo, exceto que também contém cerca de 100.000 folículos capilares que dão origem ao cabelo. Os folículos capilares e capilares são um derivado do tecido da pele. Existem duas camadas distintas de pele, uma a epiderme (camada externa) que dá origem ao escudo protetor do corpo e a outra, a camada dérmica (camada profunda) que compõe o volume da pele e é onde o folículo capilar está localizado.

Esta camada dérmica é composta de tecido conjuntivo e o tecido conjuntivo, com suas características gelatinosas como fluido oferece suporte, nutre e hidrata as camadas profundas do couro cabeludo. O resultado é um cabelo lustroso saudável e um couro cabeludo hidratado. Novamente, tudo isso é possível devido à presença de HA no tecido do couro cabeludo e sua capacidade de formar este fluido e manter a água.

常见问题

我可以在我的其他护发产品中使用 Episilk™ 护发素吗?

有。 Episilk™ 护发素可与任何其他头发产品一起使用,在使用 Episilk™ 洗发水之前使用,效果特别好。

透明质酸能对头发和头皮有什么作用?

从结构上来说,头皮与全身的皮肤组织相同,但它也含有大约 100,000 个头发毛囊。 头发和毛囊是皮肤组织的衍生物。 有两个独特的皮肤层,一个是产生身体保护盾的表皮(外层),另一个是占皮肤体积的真皮层(深层层),是毛囊所在地。

这款真皮层由结缔组织和结缔组织组成,具有凝胶状液体特性,提供支撑、滋养和保湿头皮深层层。 其结果是健康有光泽的头发和滋润头皮。 再一次,所有的这一切都是可能的,因为透明质酸在头皮组织中存在,以及其形成这种液体和保持水的能力。

title: PHYTO Phytojoba Moisturizing Mask, 5.29 oz
bullet_point: [This rich mask detangles and intensely moisturizes the hair fiber, Easy to comb out, the hair regains its softness and suppleness., The hair is light and instantly and sustainably regains its bounce., For express care, leave on for 1 to 2 minutes. Rinse., or intense care, leave on for 5 to 7 minutes depending on the thickness of the hair. Rinse.]
description:
A deeply hydrating, shine-enhancing mask that weightlessly restores softness and luster to dry hair. This indulgent conditioning mask enriched with jojoba oil melts into hair to moisturize intensely and detangle weightlessly.Bullets: A unique concentration of angelica root extract and sweet orange essential oil imparts glossy shine and vitality; hair regains its softness and elasticity. Formulated to hydrate and protect dry hair. Enriched with wheat micro-proteins and sweet orange essential oil. Nurtures and softens dry hair. Imparts vitality to dull, dehydrated hair. Key Ingredients: Jojoba oil: Rich in fatty acids, Jojoba oil restores the hydrolipid film and prevents dehydration. Its unique structure offers an intense conditioning effect that makes it easy to comb through and manage the hair. Its antioxidant vitamin E helps protect the fiber from daily aggressions.Mallow extraction: A powerful moistening agent, Mallow is recognized for its high mucilage content. When they come into contact with water, these polysaccharides form an invisible barrier that maintains hydration at the heart of the fiber.Pea proteins: Hair becomes suppler and less fragile due to its humectant properties. These attach easily to the hair surface, retain water molecules present in the environment and allow moisturizing hair.

Una máscara profundamente hidratante, que mejora el brillo y restaura sin peso la suavidad y el brillo al cabello seco. Esta mascarilla acondicionadora indulgente enriquecida con aceite de jojoba se funde en el cabello para hidratar intensamente y desenredar sin peso. Balas: Una concentración única de extracto de raíz de angélica y aceite esencial de naranja dulce imparte brillo y vitalidad brillante; el cabello recupera su suavidad y elasticidad. Formulado para hidratar y proteger el cabello seco. Enriquecido con microproteínas de trigo y aceite esencial de naranja dulce. Nutre y suaviza el cabello seco. Imparte vitalidad al cabello aburrido y deshidratado. Ingredientes clave: Aceite de jojoba: Rico en ácidos grasos, aceite de jojoba restaura la película hidrolipídica y previene la deshidratación. Su estructura única ofrece un efecto acondicionador intenso que facilita el peinado y la gestión del cabello. Su vitamina E antioxidante ayuda a proteger la fibra de las agresiones diarias.Extracción de malva: Un potente agente humectante, Malva es reconocido por su alto contenido de mucílago. Cuando entran en contacto con el agua, estos polisacáridos forman una barrera invisible que mantiene la hidratación en el corazón de la fibra.Proteínas de guisantes: El cabello se vuelve más flexible y menos frágil debido a sus propiedades humectantes. Estos se adhieren fácilmente a la superficie del cabello, retienen las moléculas de agua presentes en el medio ambiente y permiten hidratar el cabello.

מסכה שמעניקה לחות עמוקה ומשפרת ברק המשחזרת את הרכות והברק ללא משקל לשיער יבש. מסכת ריכוך מפנקת זו מועשרת בשמן חוחובה נמסה לתוך השיער כדי להעניק לחות אינטנסיבית ולהתיר קשרים במשקל. קליעים: ריכוז ייחודי של תמצית שורש אנג'ליקה ושמן אתרי כתום מתוק מקנה ברק וחיוניות מבריקים; השיער חוזר לרכות וגמישותו. נוסחה כדי להעניק לחות והגנה על שיער יבש. מועשר במיקרו חלבונים חיטה ושמן אתרי כתום מתוק. מטפח ומרכך שיער יבש. מקנה חיוניות לשיער משעמם ומיובש. מרכיבים עיקריים: שמן חוחובה: עשיר בחומצות שומן, שמן חוחובה משחזר את הסרט ההידרוליפידי ומונע התייבשות. המבנה הייחודי שלו מציע אפקט ריכוך אינטנסיבי שמקל על מסרק ולנהל את השיער. ויטמין E נוגד החמצון שלו עוזר להגן על הסיבים מפני תוקפנות יומיומית. מיצוי מלאי: חומר לחות חזק, Mallow מוכר בשל תכולת הרירית הגבוהה שלו. כאשר הם באים במגע עם מים, סוכרים אלה יוצרים מחסום בלתי נראה אשר שומר על לחות בלב הסיבים. חלבוני אפונה: השיער הופך להיות גמיש ופחות שביר בשל תכונות humectant שלו. אלה מתחברים בקלות למשטח השיער, שומרים על מולקולות המים הקיימות בסביבה ומאפשרות לחות שיער.

Eine tief feuchtigkeitsspendende, glanzverstärkende Maske, die schwerelos Weichheit und Glanz für trockenes Haar wiederherstellt. Diese verwöhnende Pflegemaske mit Jojoba-Öl schmilzt in das Haar, um intensiv mit Feuchtigkeit zu versorgen und schwerelos zu entwirren. Bullets: Eine einzigartige Konzentration aus Engelwurzelextrakt und süßem Orangenöl verleiht Glanz und Vitalität; Haar erhält seine Weichheit und Elastizität. Formuliert, um trockenes Haar zu spenden und zu schützen. Angereichert mit Weizen-Mikroproteinen und ätherischem Süßorangenöl. Pflegt und erweicht trockenes Haar. Verleiht stumpfem, dehydriertem Haar Vitalität. Hauptinhaltsstoffe: Jojobaöl: Reich an Fettsäuren, Jojobaöl stellt den Hydrolipidfilm wieder her und verhindert Austrocknen. Seine einzigartige Struktur bietet einen intensiven Conditioning-Effekt, der das Durchkämmen und Verwalten des Haares erleichtert. Sein antioxidatives Vitamin E hilft, die Faser vor täglichen Aggressionen zu schützen. Malvenextraktion: Ein leistungsstarkes Feuchtigkeitsmittel, Malve ist bekannt für seinen hohen Schleimgehalt. Wenn sie mit Wasser in Berührung kommen, bilden diese Polysaccharide eine unsichtbare Barriere, die die Feuchtigkeit im Herzen der Faser aufrechterhält. Erbsenproteine: Das Haar wird aufgrund seiner Feuchthalteigenschaften geschmeidiger und weniger zerbrechlich. Diese lassen sich leicht an der Haaroberfläche befestigen, halten Wassermoleküle in der Umgebung und ermöglichen das feuchtigkeitsspendende Haar.

Uma máscara profundamente hidratante e que melhora o brilho que restaura a suavidade e o brilho ao cabelo seco. Esta máscara condicionadora indulgente enriquecida com óleo de jojoba derrete no cabelo para hidratar intensamente e desembaraçar levemente. Balas: uma concentração única de extrato de raiz de angélica e óleo essencial de laranja doce transmite brilho brilhante e vitalidade; o cabelo recupera sua suavidade e elasticidade. Formulado para hidratar e proteger o cabelo seco. Enriquecido com microproteínas de trigo e óleo essencial de laranja doce. Nutre e suaviza o cabelo seco. Dá vitalidade a cabelos opacos e desidratados. Ingredientes principais: óleo de jojoba: rico em ácidos graxos, óleo de jojoba restaura o filme hidrolipídico e evita a desidratação. Sua estrutura única oferece um efeito de condicionamento intenso que facilita pentear e gerenciar o cabelo. Sua vitamina E antioxidante ajuda a proteger a fibra das agressões diárias. Extrção malvada: um poderoso agente umidificante, Mallow é reconhecido por seu alto teor de mucilagem. Quando eles entram em contato com a água, estes polissacarídeos formam uma barreira invisível que mantém a hidratação no coração da fibra. Proteínas da ervilha: o cabelo torna-se mais flexível e menos frágil devido às suas propriedades umectantes. Eles se prendem facilmente à superfície do cabelo, retêm as moléculas de água presentes no meio ambiente e permitem hidratar o cabelo.

Fine hair

Fine hair is usually genetic, but it can also be the result of nutrient deficiency or poor blood circulation of the scalp. Due to dwindling hormone production with age hair can become thinner. Fine hair is thinner than normal hair, but there is more of it. It measures on average between 0.03 and 0.05 mm in diameter. It has less volume, is more sensitive and reacts faster to the frictional forces of hair brushes and combs, e.g. with electrostatic build-up.

description: Providing unprecedented underwater clarity on its 12.1-inch high-definition touchscreen, the SOLIX 12 G2 with MEGA Down Imaging+ (DI+) features crystal-clear coverage down to 200 feet below your boat to unlock more fish and structure with up to 20% more detail. Humminbird's MEGA Imaging+ sonar frequency is three times greater than traditional 455 kHz frequencies, resulting in the clearest, sharpest underwater views. The built-in Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar identifies well-defined fish arches and provides clear views of fish-holding structure and the bottom. It also provides two ways to search for fish: Wide Mode for maximum coverage and Narrow Mode for maximum detail. It's complemented by Humminbird's innovative SwitchFire sonar feature, which enables you to add or remove detail easily; account for water depth, temperature, and turbulence; and even watch lure presentations. The SOLIX G2 comes with Humminbird’s easy-to-use Cross Touch Interface, letting you control the fish finder via 12.1-inch touchscreen (1280 x 800) or keypad all while customizing the screen with up to four independent viewing panes. The built-in basemap enables you to identify buoys, day markers, hazards, marinas, contours, depth markers, and more, and it Includes charts of more than 10,000 lakes plus coastal coverage for the U.S US. The built-in Bluetooth connectivity allows you to keep your phone out of the water and in your pocket with onscreen notification displays, and it provides enhanced networking abilities when networked with other SOLIX units. High-speed Ethernet connectivity allows you to build a powerful, professional-grade fishing system that enables you to connect to multiple fish finders or upgrade to add-on technologies like Minn Kota i-Pilot Link, 360 Imaging and CHIRP Radar (sold separately). The SOLIX G2 also comes with Wi-Fi connectivity for optional features. Measuring 13.82 x 9.55 x 4.79 inches (WxHxD) via standard gimbal mounting, the SOLIX 12 includes a power cable, gimbal mounting bracket, and unit cover; this Control Head Only (CHO) model does not include a transducer. This model will also connect directly to built-in MEGA DI transducers found on select Minn Kota trolling motors (no adapter required; sold separately). The SOLIX 12 can also be integrated into your dash using the In-Dash Mounting Kit (sold separately).

We are a premium multi-cultural healthy hair growth and retention company, and we attentively and thoroughly listen to the voices of our consumers to create a solution to their hair problems.
We built our company on the foundation of research and the "beauty, health, science" approach: enhance beauty and health with a scientific background.
We offer a comprehensive methodology to achieving beautiful, healthy hair, by infusing our hair care products with vitamins and essential nutrients such as Biotin, Vitamin A, B, C, D, & E and more.
We believe in maintaining an intimate relationship with our team, our customers, and the consumers.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection is a major key to maximizing moisture retention. Our advanced moisturizing blend is infused with essential vitamins and Moringa Oleifera Seed Oil, which is derived from The Moringa Tree, also known as the "healing" tree, that deeply penetrates the hair shaft to infuse it with vital moisture and nutrients. Power-packed to improve shine, strength, and manageability.

DIRECTIONS: After shampooing with Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo, apply a generous amount from roots to ends. Massage gently into the hair, especially the ends, and distribute evenly. Cover hair with a plastic cap and sit under the dryer for 15 minutes, or leave in up to 1 hour without heat. Rinse thoroughly with cool water. Style as usual. Use every 1-2 weeks for best results.



¿Quién es la elección de la melena?

Somos una empresa de crecimiento y retención de cabello saludable multicultural premium, y escuchamos atenta y minuciosamente las voces de nuestros consumidores para crear una solución a sus problemas de cabello.
Construimos nuestra empresa sobre la base de la investigación y el enfoque "belleza, salud, ciencia": mejorar la belleza y la salud con un fondo científico.
Ofrecemos una metodología integral para lograr un cabello hermoso y saludable, infundiendo nuestros productos de cuidado del cabello con vitaminas y nutrientes esenciales como Biotina, Vitamina A, B, C, D y E y más.
Creemos en mantener una relación íntima con nuestro equipo, nuestros clientes y los consumidores.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection es una clave importante para maximizar la retención de humedad. Nuestra mezcla hidratante avanzada está infundida con vitaminas esenciales y aceite de semilla de Moringa Oleifera, que se deriva del árbol de Moringa, también conocido como el árbol de "curación", que penetra profundamente en el tallo del cabello para infundirlo con humedad vital y nutrientes. Potencia para mejorar el brillo, la fuerza y la manejabilidad.

DIRECCIONES: Después del champú con Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo, aplique una cantidad generosa de raíces a extremos. Masajee suavemente en el cabello, especialmente en los extremos, y distribuya uniformemente. Cubra el cabello con una tapa de plástico y siéntese debajo de la secadora durante 15 minutos, o déjelo en hasta 1 hora sin calor. Enjuague bien con agua fría. Estilo como de costumbre. Use cada 1-2 semanas para obtener los mejores resultados.



מי זו הבחירה הרעמה?

אנחנו חברת צמיחת שיער ושימור פרימיום בריאה, רב-תרבותית ואנו מקשיבים בתשומת לב וביסודיות לקולות של הצרכנים שלנו כדי ליצור פתרון לבעיות השיער שלהם.
בנינו את החברה שלנו על בסיס המחקר ואת הגישה "יופי, בריאות, מדע": לשפר יופי ובריאות עם רקע מדעי.
אנו מציעים מתודולוגיה מקיפה להשגת שיער יפה ובריא, על ידי החדרת מוצרי טיפוח השיער שלנו עם ויטמינים וחומרים מזינים חיוניים כגון ביוטין, ויטמין A, B, C, D & E ועוד.
אנו מאמינים בשמירה על מערכת יחסים אינטימית עם הצוות שלנו, הלקוחות שלנו והצרכנים.

קולקציית הלחות האינסופית של שמן מתוק ודבש של Moringa היא המפתח העיקרי למיקסום שמירת הלחות. תערובת הלחות המתקדמת שלנו כוללת ויטמינים חיוניים ושמן זרעי Moringa Oleifera שמקורם בעץ המורינגה, הידוע גם בשם עץ "ריפוי", אשר חודר עמוק לתוך מוט השיער כדי להחדיר אותו עם לחות וחומרים מזינים חיוניים. ארוז בחשמל כדי לשפר ברק, חוזק ויכולת הניהול.

הוראות: לאחר החפיפה עם שמן מתוק ומורינגה טרופית ושמפו לחות אינסופי, מרחו כמות נדיבה מהשורשים לקצוות. עסו בעדינות לתוך השיער, במיוחד את הקצוות, והפצו באופן שווה. כסו את השיער עם מכסה פלסטיק וישבו מתחת למייבש במשך 15 דקות, או השאירו עד שעה אחת ללא חום. שטפו ביסודיות במים קרים. סגנון כרגיל. השתמשו כל 1-2 שבועות לקבלת התוצאות הטובות ביותר.



Wer ist die richtige Mähne?

Wir sind ein erstklassiges multikulturelles gesundes Haarwachstum und Retention Unternehmen, und wir hören aufmerksam und gründlich auf die Stimmen unserer Verbraucher, um eine Lösung für ihre Haarprobleme zu schaffen.
Wir bauten unser Unternehmen auf der Grundlage der Forschung und dem Ansatz "Schönheit, Gesundheit, Wissenschaften" auf: Verbesserung der Schönheit und Gesundheit mit einem wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund.
Wir bieten eine umfassende Methodologie, um schönes, gesundes Haar zu erreichen, indem wir unsere Haarpflegeprodukte mit Vitaminen und essentiellen Nährstoffen wie Biotin, Vitamin A, B, C, D, & E und mehr infundieren.
Wir glauben daran, eine intime Beziehung zu unserem Team, unseren Kunden und den Verbrauchern aufrechtzuerhalten.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection ist ein wichtiger Schlüssel zur Maximierung der Feuchtigkeitsspeicherung. Unsere fortschrittliche feuchtigkeitsspendende Mischung ist mit essentiellen Vitaminen und Moringa Oleifera Samenöl angereichert, das aus dem Moringa-Baum gewonnen wird, auch bekannt als "heilenden" Baum, das tief in den Haarschaft eindringt, um es mit lebenswichtigen Feuchtigkeit und Nährstoffen zu versorgen. Power-packed to improve shine, strength and manageability.

Anwendung: Nach dem Shampoonieren mit Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo eine großzügige Menge vom Ansatz bis zu den Spitzen auftragen. Sanft ins Haar einmassieren, insbesondere in die Spitzen, und gleichmäßig verteilen. Bedecken Sie das Haar mit einer Kunststoffkappe und legen Sie es für 15 Minuten unter den Trockner, oder lassen Sie es bis zu 1 Stunde ohne Hitze einwirken. Mit kaltem Wasser gründlich ausspülen. Wie gewohnt stylen. Für beste Ergebnisse alle 1-2 Wochen verwenden.



من هي مان تشويس؟

نحن شركة فاخرة متعددة الثقافات لنمو الشعر والحفاظ عليه، ونحن نستمع بعناية ودقة إلى أصوات المستهلكين لخلق حل لمشكلات الشعر.
لقد بنينا شركتنا على أساس البحث ونهج "الجمال والصحة والعلم": تعزيز الجمال والصحة بخلفية علمية.
نقدم منهجية شاملة للحصول على شعر جميل وصحي من خلال غمر منتجات العناية بالشعر الخاصة بنا بالفيتامينات والمغذيات الأساسية مثل البيوتين وفيتامين أ وب وسي ودي واي وغيرها.
نحن نؤمن بالحفاظ على علاقة ودية مع فريقنا وعملائنا ومستهلكين.

مجموعة الترطيب تروبيكال مورينجا من الزيوت الحلوة والعسل هي مفتاح رئيسي لزيادة الاحتفاظ بالرطوبة. مزيج الترطيب المتطور الخاص بنا غني بالفيتامينات الأساسية وزيت بذور المورينغا أوليفيرا، المشتق من شجرة المورينجا، المعروفة أيضًا باسم شجرة "الشفاء"، التي تتغلغل بعمق في ساق الشعر لتغمرها بالرطوبة والمغذيات الحيوية. معبأة بالطاقة لتحسين اللمعان والقوة وسهولة التصفيف.

الإرشادات: بعد غسل الشعر بالشامبو بزيت المورينغا الحلو والعسل المرطب من تروبيكال مورينغا ضعي كمية وفيرة من الجذور حتى الأطراف. دلكيه بلطف على الشعر، خاصة الأطراف، ووزعيه بالتساوي. قومي بتغطية الشعر بغطاء بلاستيكي واتركيه تحت المجفف لمدة 15 دقيقة، أو اتركيه لمدة تصل إلى ساعة واحدة بدون حرارة. يشطف بالكامل بالماء البارد. صففي شعرك كالمعتاد. استخدميه كل أسبوع إلى أسبوعين للحصول على أفضل النتائج.



Quem é a escolha da crina?

Somos uma empresa de crescimento e retenção de cabelo saudável multicultural premium, e ouvimos com atenção e atenção as vozes de nossos consumidores para criar uma solução para seus problemas de cabelo.
Construímos nossa empresa com base na pesquisa e na abordagem de "beleza, saúde, ciência": melhorar a beleza e a saúde com uma experiência científica.
Oferecemos uma metodologia abrangente para atingir cabelos bonitos e saudáveis, infundindo nossos produtos de cuidados com o cabelo com vitaminas e nutrientes essenciais como biotina, vitamina A, B, C, D, E e mais.
Acreditamos em manter um relacionamento íntimo com nossa equipe, nossos clientes e os consumidores.

A coleção Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture é uma importante chave para maximizar a retenção de umidade. Nossa avançada mistura hidratante é infundida com vitaminas essenciais e óleo de semente de Moringa Oleifera, que é derivado da Moringa Tree, também conhecida como a árvore de "cura", que penetra profundamente no eixo capilar para infundir umidade e nutrientes vitais. Equipada para melhorar o brilho, força e manuseio.

INSTRUÇÕES: Após lavar o xampu com óleo doce de moringa tropical e mel Endless Moisture, aplique uma quantidade generosa das raízes às pontas. Massageie suavemente no cabelo, especialmente nas pontas e distribua uniformemente. Cubra o cabelo com uma tampa de plástico e sente-se sob a secadora por 15 minutos, ou deixe em até 1 hora sem calor. Enxágue completamente com água fria. Estilo como de costume. Use a cada 1-2 semanas para melhores resultados.



Mane 的选择是谁?

我们是一家优质的多文化健康的头发生长和保留公司,我们精心彻底倾听消费者的声音,创造解决头发问题的解决方案。
我们建立在研究的基础上,"美容、健康、科学"方法的基础上:用科学背景来增强美容和健康。
我们为头发护理产品注入维生素和必需营养素,如生物素、维生素 A、B、C、D 和 E 等,提供一种全面的方法来实现美丽健康的头发。
我们坚信与团队、客户和消费者保持亲密关系。

热带辣木甜油和蜂蜜无尽保湿系列是最大限度地保持水分的主要关键。 我们的高级保湿混合物注入了必需的维生素和辣木籽油,这种油来自辣木,也称为"治愈"树,深入渗透发干,为其注入重要的水分和营养素。 力量包装以提高光泽、强度和易打理性。

说明:使用热带辣木甜油和蜂蜜无尽保湿洗发水,洗发后,从根部到发梢涂抹大量。 轻轻按摩头发,尤其是发梢,均匀分布。 用塑料帽盖住头发,放在烘干机下 15 分钟,或保持长达 1 小时不加热。 用冷水彻底冲洗。 像平常一样风格。 每 1-2 周使用一次,以获得最佳效果。



誰是鬃毛的選擇?

我們是一家優質的多文化健康頭髮生長和保留公司,我們認真徹底地聆聽消費者的聲音,以創造解決頭髮問題的解決方案。
我們公司建立在研究的基礎上,並以「美容、健康、科學」方法:以科學背景增強美與健康。
我們提供全方位方法,透過將頭髮護理產品注入生物素、維他命 A、B、C、D 和 E 等必需營養素,實現美麗健康的頭髮。
我們相信與我們的團隊、顧客和消費者保持親密關係。 ​

Tropical Moringa 甜油和蜂蜜無盡的保濕系列是最大限度地提高保濕效果的主要關鍵。 我們先進的保濕混合物注入基本維生素和辣木Oleifera 籽油,其來源於辣木樹,也稱為「癒合」樹,深層穿透頭髮軸,注入重要的水分和營養。 強力包裝,改善光澤、強度和易整理性。

使用說明:使用 Tropical Moringa 甜油和蜂蜜無盡的保濕洗髮精進行洗髮後,塗抹大量從根部到末端。 輕輕按摩頭髮,尤其是末端,均勻分佈。 用塑料蓋蓋住頭髮,在烘乾機下坐著 15 分鐘,或靜置 1 小時,不加熱。 用冷水徹底沖洗。 一如既往的風格。 每 1-2 週使用一次以獲得最佳效果。



갈기 선택은 누구입니까?

저희는 프리미엄 다문화적인 건강한 모발 성장 및 유지 회사로, 모발 문제에 대한 해결책을 만들기 위해 소비자의 목소리를 세심하고 철저하게 경청합니다.
저희는 연구의 기초와 "아름다움, 건강, 과학" 접근 방식을 바탕으로 회사를 구축했습니다. 과학적인 배경으로 아름다움과 건강을 향상시킵니다.
저희는 헤어 케어 제품에 비오틴, 비타민 A, B, C, D, E 등과 같은 필수 영양소를 주입하여 아름답고 건강한 모발을 달성하는 종합적인 방법을 제공합니다.
저희는 팀, 고객 및 소비자와의 친밀한 관계를 유지하는 것을 믿습니다.

트로피컬 모링가 스위트 오일 & 허니 엔드리스 모이스처 컬렉션은 수분 보존을 극대화하는 주요 열쇠입니다. 당사의 고급 보습 블렌드는 필수 비타민과 모링가 올레페라 씨드 오일이 함유되어 있습니다. 모링가 나무에서 추출한 모링가 올레페라 씨드 오일은 모낭에 깊이 침투하여 중요한 수분과 영양소를 주입합니다. 광택, 강도 및 관리 편의성을 향상시키기 위해 전원 포장.

사용 방법: 트로피컬 모링가 스위트 오일 & 허니 엔드리스 모이스처 샴푸로 샴푸한 후 뿌리부터 끝까지 충분한 양을 바르세요. 머리카락, 특히 끝 부분에 부드럽게 마사지하고 고르게 분배합니다. 플라스틱 캡으로 머리카락을 덮고 건조기 아래에 15분간 두거나 열을 가하지 않고 최대 1시간 동안 방치하십시오. 찬물로 완전히 헹구십시오. 평소와 같은 스타일. 최상의 결과를 위해 1-2주마다 사용하세요.

Rinse thoroughly with cool water. Style as usual. Use every 1-2 weeks for best results.



¿Quién es la elección de la melena?

Somos una empresa de crecimiento y retención de cabello saludable multicultural premium, y escuchamos atenta y minuciosamente las voces de nuestros consumidores para crear una solución a sus problemas de cabello.
Construimos nuestra empresa sobre la base de la investigación y el enfoque "belleza, salud, ciencia": mejorar la belleza y la salud con un fondo científico.
Ofrecemos una metodología integral para lograr un cabello hermoso y saludable, infundiendo nuestros productos de cuidado del cabello con vitaminas y nutrientes esenciales como Biotina, Vitamina A, B, C, D y E y más.
Creemos en mantener una relación íntima con nuestro equipo, nuestros clientes y los consumidores.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection es una clave importante para maximizar la retención de humedad. Nuestra mezcla hidratante avanzada está infundida con vitaminas esenciales y aceite de semilla de Moringa Oleifera, que se deriva del árbol de Moringa, también conocido como el árbol de "curación", que penetra profundamente en el tallo del cabello para infundirlo con humedad vital y nutrientes. Potencia para mejorar el brillo, la fuerza y la manejabilidad.

DIRECCIONES: Después del champú con Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo, aplique una cantidad generosa de raíces a extremos. Masajee suavemente en el cabello, especialmente en los extremos, y distribuya uniformemente. Cubra el cabello con una tapa de plástico y siéntese debajo de la secadora durante 15 minutos, o déjelo en hasta 1 hora sin calor. Enjuague bien con agua fría. Estilo como de costumbre. Use cada 1-2 semanas para obtener los mejores resultados.



מי זו הבחירה הרעמה?

אנחנו חברת צמיחת שיער ושימור פרימיום בריאה, רב-תרבותית ואנו מקשיבים בתשומת לב וביסודיות לקולות של הצרכנים שלנו כדי ליצור פתרון לבעיות השיער שלהם.
בנינו את החברה שלנו על בסיס המחקר ואת הגישה "יופי, בריאות, מדע": לשפר יופי ובריאות עם רקע מדעי.
אנו מציעים מתודולוגיה מקיפה להשגת שיער יפה ובריא, על ידי החדרת מוצרי טיפוח השיער שלנו עם ויטמינים וחומרים מזינים חיוניים כגון ביוטין, ויטמין A, B, C, D & E ועוד.
אנו מאמינים בשמירה על מערכת יחסים אינטימית עם הצוות שלנו, הלקוחות שלנו והצרכנים.

קולקציית הלחות האינסופית של שמן מתוק ודבש של Moringa היא המפתח העיקרי למיקסום שמירת הלחות. תערובת הלחות המתקדמת שלנו כוללת ויטמינים חיוניים ושמן זרעי Moringa Oleifera שמקורם בעץ המורינגה, הידוע גם בשם עץ "ריפוי", אשר חודר עמוק לתוך מוט השיער כדי להחדיר אותו עם לחות וחומרים מזינים חיוניים. ארוז בחשמל כדי לשפר ברק, חוזק ויכולת הניהול.

הוראות: לאחר החפיפה עם שמן מתוק ומורינגה טרופית ושמפו לחות אינסופי, מרחו כמות נדיבה מהשורשים לקצוות. עסו בעדינות לתוך השיער, במיוחד את הקצוות, והפצו באופן שווה. כסו את השיער עם מכסה פלסטיק וישבו מתחת למייבש במשך 15 דקות, או השאירו עד שעה אחת ללא חום. שטפו ביסודיות במים קרים. סגנון כרגיל. השתמשו כל 1-2 שבועות לקבלת התוצאות הטובות ביותר.



Wer ist die richtige Mähne?

Wir sind ein erstklassiges multikulturelles gesundes Haarwachstum und Retention Unternehmen, und wir hören aufmerksam und gründlich auf die Stimmen unserer Verbraucher, um eine Lösung für ihre Haarprobleme zu schaffen.
Wir bauten unser Unternehmen auf der Grundlage der Forschung und dem Ansatz "Schönheit, Gesundheit, Wissenschaften" auf: Verbesserung der Schönheit und Gesundheit mit einem wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund.
Wir bieten eine umfassende Methodologie, um schönes, gesundes Haar zu erreichen, indem wir unsere Haarpflegeprodukte mit Vitaminen und essentiellen Nährstoffen wie Biotin, Vitamin A, B, C, D, & E und mehr infundieren.
Wir glauben daran, eine intime Beziehung zu unserem Team, unseren Kunden und den Verbrauchern aufrechtzuerhalten.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection ist ein wichtiger Schlüssel zur Maximierung der Feuchtigkeitsspeicherung. Unsere fortschrittliche feuchtigkeitsspendende Mischung ist mit essentiellen Vitaminen und Moringa Oleifera Samenöl angereichert, das aus dem Moringa-Baum gewonnen wird, auch bekannt als "heilenden" Baum, das tief in den Haarschaft eindringt, um es mit lebenswichtigen Feuchtigkeit und Nährstoffen zu versorgen. Power-packed to improve shine, strength and manageability.

Anwendung: Nach dem Shampoonieren mit Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo eine großzügige Menge vom Ansatz bis zu den Spitzen auftragen. Sanft ins Haar einmassieren, insbesondere in die Spitzen, und gleichmäßig verteilen. AGAVE FRUCTANS

Our Botanical Beauty researchers have unlocked the secret of Agave Tequilana: its richness in fructans, source of energy for the plant. JOJOBA OIL

Jojoba is a small shrub adapted to desert climates. To ensure its survival, it has to concentrate as much energy as possible into its seeds, which have to start germinating at the slightest outside stimulus like rain and grow into a new plant. This energy reserve is in the form of a liquid wax commonly known as Jojoba oil, rich in omega-6 and 9 fatty acids. This oil is essential to the plant and is called "desert gold". It is also vital to damaged hair for its ability to reconstitute the hair fiber.

description:
The Pharmacos Cupuacu Conditioner contains in its formulation cupuaçu extract, a fruit of the Amazon Forest. This fruit has high hydration power, which associated with keratin, silicones and panthenol, promote the restoration of the hair fiber and protect the wires against the effects of wind, pollution.

Cupuaçu (Theobroma Grandiflorum) is the fruit of a tree native to the Brazilian Amazon related to the cocoa tree. This fruit was a primary source of food in the Amazon forest both for the indigenous populations and animals.

It became known for its creamy pulp and exotic flavor. The seeds of the cupuaçu have high levels of fat. In the cosmetic industry it is used to provide hydration, due to its high water absorption capacity, which makes it possible to recover the skin’s natural moist as well as the hair’s.

Cupuaçu butter acts on the skin tissue as a protective film which prevents the evaporation of the water through the skin.

Benefits of Cupuaçu

Cupuaçu oil and cupuaçu butter have significant benefits for your hair. Although it’s not as well known as superfruits like Açai, Cupuaçu is gradually becoming recognized for its place as one of nature’s most powerful, antioxidant-rich moisturizers.

It even surpasses beloved hydrating butters such shea butter by 2x and lanolin, and has an unmatched ability to retain moisture.

Studies have found cupuaçu butter to keep skin moisturized as much as eight hours after application! In addition to repairing your skin’s moisture barrier, cupuaçu will improve the elasticity and firmness of your hair, keep your hair looking and feeling smoother and more hydrated, reducing the appearance of any imperfections.

Cupuaçu is also used as an alternative to shea butter for treating dry or brittle hair, improving hydration, shine, and softness. It’s an excellent treatment for your hair after coloring, to reduce potential damage.

description:
At Nexxus, we understand that the hair structure consists of up to 90% protein, so we believe helping hair return to its optimal state means treating it with protein at high levels. Nexxus scientists set out to find inspiration from precious ingredients that could help seal severely damaged hair using a leading edge approach to protein research called Proteomics. The Nexxus Keraphix Healing System for Severely Damaged Hair, with Keratin Protein and Black Rice, heals visible signs of severe hair damage. Rice has long been a storied secret of strong heathy hair for women of the Huangluo village in China, where fermented rice water has unlocked the key to growing long, luxurious hair. Women of the village go to great lengths to preserve their hair by washing it in fermented rice water and often undergo just one haircut their entire lifetime. Extensive testing showed that Glutamic Acid is a key amino acid lost in hair when it is exposed to severe damage. After finding that Black Rice was among the richest sources of Glutamic Acid in nature, Nexxus combined this ingredient with Keratin Protein and other essential nutrients to create a new hair healing ritual for clinically proven healthy-looking hair with just one use. Salon-crafted with our exclusive PROTEINFUSION blend with Keratin Protein and Black Rice, Keraphix Conditioner acts as the second step of the treatment process, healing signs of damage while bringing strength with weightless effect. Step 1: Apply Keraphix Shampoo for Severely Damaged Hair to wet hair and experience the rich foamy lather. Rinse thoroughly. Step 2: Follow with Keraphix Conditioner for Severely Damaged Hair or Keraphix Masque for Severely Damaged Hair to help heal signs of damage. Step 3: Once a week, follow with the Keraphix Reconstructing Treatment for a complete hair treatment for healthy-looking, soft and smooth hair.

description:
Designed to volumize thin, fine and weak hair. Counteracts and blocks DHT. Unique blend of natural ingredients, no heavy chemicals. Adds softness and volume without weighing hair down.

Package states, "Male and female pattern baldness (medically known as Androgenetic alopecia) have been tied to a group of hormones know as androgens which includes testosterone and dihydrotestosterone (DHT). Both androgens are found in men's bodies in large amounts and in women's bodies in lesser amounts. When testosterone comes into contact with the enzyme 5-alpha reductase found in the hair follicles, it is converted into the derivative DHT. The more potent androgen DHT in the hair follicle over time leads to the follicle shrinking. This process causes follicles to become unable to produce and maintain normal hair growth interrupting the natural hair-growth/replacement cycle and resulting in hair loss."

DIRECTIONS FOR USE: "After shampooing with My Secret Hair Enhancing Shampoo with DHT Blocker System, apply Hair Enhancing Volumizing Conditioner from roots to ends of hair strands. Leave in for 3 to 5 minutes then rinse thoroughly."

INGREDIENTS: "Water, Cetrimonium Bromide, Olive (Olea Europaea) Oil, Mineral Oil, Ceteareth-20, Glycerin, Petrolatum, Propylene Glycol, Panthenol, Nettle Leaf (uritca Dioica) Extract, Saw Palmetto (Serena Repens), Oat (Avena Sativa) Extract, Camomille (Matricarin) Extract, Diazolidinyl Urea, Methylparaben, Proplylparaben, Fragrance."

Fine hair

Fine hair is usually genetic, but it can also be the result of nutrient deficiency or poor blood circulation of the scalp. Due to dwindling hormone production with age hair can become thinner. Fine hair is thinner than normal hair, but there is more of it. It measures on average between 0.03 and 0.05 mm in diameter. It has less volume, is more sensitive and reacts faster to the frictional forces of hair brushes and combs, e.g. with electrostatic build-up.

AGAVE FRUCTANS

Our Botanical Beauty researchers have unlocked the secret of Agave Tequilana: its richness in fructans, source of energy for the plant. Agave fructans have never before been used as a cosmetics extract. They work where the hair gets all its strength, in the scalp itself. MORINGA SEEDS

Moringa seeds are an amazing natural water purifier, one of the best discovered to this day. Because of the peptides in Moringa seeds, they can capture polluting particulates. They have a positive charge, they attract and neutralize impurities in muddy water causing them to fall to the bottom of the container. Then, the purified water can be collected after decanting. Therefore, it was only natural that our Botanical Beauty researchers decided to use the properties of Moringa to eliminate pollution in hair. Based on that same impurity-capturing action, the Moringa seed extract purifies the scalp, the hair fiber recovers its lightness, and hair can breathe once again and regains its radiance.

description: Providing unprecedented underwater clarity on its 12.1-inch high-definition touchscreen, the SOLIX 12 G2 with MEGA Down Imaging+ (DI+) features crystal-clear coverage down to 200 feet below your boat to unlock more fish and structure with up to 20% more detail. Humminbird's MEGA Imaging+ sonar frequency is three times greater than traditional 455 kHz frequencies, resulting in the clearest, sharpest underwater views. The built-in Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar identifies well-defined fish arches and provides clear views of fish-holding structure and the bottom. It also provides two ways to search for fish: Wide Mode for maximum coverage and Narrow Mode for maximum detail. It's complemented by Humminbird's innovative SwitchFire sonar feature, which enables you to add or remove detail easily; account for water depth, temperature, and turbulence; and even watch lure presentations. The SOLIX G2 comes with Humminbird’s easy-to-use Cross Touch Interface, letting you control the fish finder via 12.1-inch touchscreen (1280 x 800) or keypad all while customizing the screen with up to four independent viewing panes. The SOLIX 12 fish finder combines precise GPS location with Humminbird's enhanced standard basemap for a clear view of underwater terrain and surrounding points of interest and includes Humminbird's AutoChart Live for creating richly detailed maps of your favorite fishing spots. The built-in basemap enables you to identify buoys, day markers, hazards, marinas, contours, depth markers, and more, and it Includes charts of more than 10,000 lakes plus coastal coverage for the U.S US. The built-in Bluetooth connectivity allows you to keep your phone out of the water and in your pocket with onscreen notification displays, and it provides enhanced networking abilities when networked with other SOLIX units. High-speed Ethernet connectivity allows you to build a powerful, professional-grade fishing system that enables you to connect to multiple fish finders or upgrade to add-on technologies like Minn Kota i-Pilot Link, 360 Imaging and CHIRP Radar (sold separately). The SOLIX G2 also comes with Wi-Fi connectivity for optional features. Measuring 13.82 x 9.55 x 4.79 inches (WxHxD) via standard gimbal mounting, the SOLIX 12 includes a power cable, gimbal mounting bracket, and unit cover; this Control Head Only (CHO) model does not include a transducer. This model will also connect directly to built-in MEGA DI transducers found on select Minn Kota trolling motors (no adapter required; sold separately). The SOLIX 12 can also be integrated into your dash using the In-Dash Mounting Kit (sold separately).

description:

Unique Slow Infusion Process to gradually infuse each ingredient into our products. Our beauty products are prepared for optimal results. Selección precisa de ingredientes naturales de la firma, conocidos por sus beneficios para el cabello y la piel. 2. Técnica de Fito-Extracción para extraer las esencias del núcleo de seis plantas – cada una reconocida por una función particular. Esta mezcla única incorporada en la base de cada uno de nuestros productos consiste en: bardana conocida por el equilibrio y desintoxicación de sauce blanco conocido por propiedades calmantes Romero conocido por la protección de los elementos Ginkgo Biloba conocido por regeneración Sage conocido por purificar Seabuckthorn conocido por revitalizar propiedades 3. Phyto-Extraction Technique כדי לחלץ את תמציות הליבה של שישה צמחים – כל אחד מוכר עבור פונקציה מסוימת. תערובת ייחודית זו משולבת לתוך הבסיס של כל אחד מהמוצרים שלנו כוללת: Burdock ידועה באיזון וסילוק רעלים ערבה לבנה ידועה בתכונות מרגיעות רוזמרין הידוע בהגנה מפני האלמנטים גינקו בילובה ידועה בהתחדשות מרווה ידועה כמטהר Seabuckthorn הידוע בתכונות חידוש 3. תהליך עירוי איטי ייחודי כדי להחדיר בהדרגה כל מרכיב לתוך המוצרים שלנו. מוצרי היופי שלנו מוכנים לתוצאות אופטימליות. כל אצווה מותאמת במיוחד כדי לייעל את שגרת טיפוח השיער ואת העור שלך לטיהור יופי יוצא דופן. אוסף Replenisher של מוצרי שיער לחות ואנטי קרזול מיועד לשיער יבש. צמד השמפו והמרכך מחליק את פני השטח של המעמד, מפחית חיכוך ומספק לחות.

Bei ApotheCARE Essentials schaffen wir eine moderne, "Neo-Apotheker"-Welt, in der die reine Essenz natürlicher Inhaltsstoffe durch einen bewährten, wissenschaftlichen Ansatz verehrt und erlebt wird, um optimierte Schönheitslösungen zu liefern. Was ist der Advanced ApotheCARE Ansatz? Unsere Wissenschaftler folgen diesem dreistufigen Ansatz, der bei der Herstellung jedes Produkts für Haar und Haut unerlässlich ist. 1. Die Replenisher Kollektion mit feuchtigkeitsspendenden und Anti-Frizz Haarprodukten ist für trockenes Haar konzipiert. في أبوذا كير إيسنشالز، ننشئ عالماً عصرياً "نيو أبوثيكير" حيث يتم الحصول على خلاصة المكونات الطبيعية وخبرتها من خلال نهج علمي مثبت الفعالية لتقديم حلول التجميل المحسنة. ما هو نهج ابوذا كير المتقدم؟ يتبع علماؤنا هذا النهج المكون من ثلاث خطوات وهو ضروري في صناعة كل منتج نصنعه لكل من الشعر والبشرة. 1. اختيار دقيق للمكونات الطبيعية المميزة المعروفة بفوائد الشعر والبشرة. 2. تقنية الاستخلاص النباتي لاستخراج المكونات الأساسية لستة نباتات – كل منها معروف بوظيفة معينة. يتكون هذا المزيج الفريد المدمج في أساس كل منتج من منتجاتنا من: الأرقطيون المعروف بالتوازن وإزالة السموم وايت ويلو المعروف بخصائص مهدئة إكليل الجبل المعروف بالحماية من العناصر الجنكة بيلوبا المعروفة بالتجديد والمريمية المعروفة بتنقية نبق البحر المعروف بخصائصها المجددة 3. عملية ضخ بطيئة فريدة من نوعها لتوزيع كل مكون تدريجيًا في منتجاتنا. منتجاتنا التجميلية جاهزة للحصول على أفضل النتائج. تم تصميم كل دفعة خصيصًا لتحسين العناية بالشعر وروتين تنظيف البشرة للحصول على جمال استثنائي. تم تصميم مجموعة ريبليشر من منتجات الشعر المرطبة والمضادة للتجعد للشعر الجاف. يعمل ثنائي الشامبو والبلسم على تنعيم سطح الوقوف وتقليل الاحتكاك وتوفير الرطوبة.

Na ApotheCare Essentials, criamos um mundo moderno, "neo-boticário" onde a essência pura dos ingredientes naturais é respeitada e experimentada através de uma abordagem científica comprovada para oferecer soluções de beleza otimizadas. O que é a abordagem avançada ApotheCare? Nossos cientistas seguem esta abordagem de três etapas que é essencial na elaboração de cada produto que fazemos para cabelo e pele. 1. Seleção precisa de ingredientes naturais característicos, conhecidos por seus benefícios de cabelo e pele. 2. 在 ApotheCARE Essentials,我们创造一个现代的"Neo-Apothecary"世界,在那里,通过经过验证的科学方法尊重并体验天然成分的纯精华,以提供优化的美容解决方案。 什么是高级 ApotheCARE 方法? 我们的科学家遵循这三步方法,这对于制作我们为头发和皮肤制作的每一件产品至关重要。 1. 精确选择标志性的天然成分,以头发和皮肤功效而闻名。 2. title: LIGHT MOUNTAIN HENNA,RED, 4 OZ
description:
Light Mountain Natural Hair Color and Conditioner Red Description: 100% Premium Henna

Henna coats each hair shaft with a natural, semi-permanent protein called hennatannic acid. Heat causes the hennatannic acid to cling to the proteins found in the hair (or nails and skin, if desired). Because henna coats and seals the hair shaft, it helps protect the hair from damaging effects of sun, salt, chlorine, wind and pollution in the environment. It can help miminize split ends and acts as “hair insurance” if you spend a lot of time in the sun, surf or wind. In addition to protecting the hair shaft, henna will tighten the hair cuticle and create a more solid surface which reflects light; the result is gleaming, lustrous hair.

Rather than producing dramatic color changes, henna enhances and deepens existing color. The darker your natural color, the less drastic the change will be inyour natural color. Because the color from henna is transparent or “seethrough,” henna cannot lighten dark hair; it will, however, add highlights to dark hair and can darken the color of lighter hair.

description:
Most conditioning products are made using silicone-based ingredients that coat the hair in something slippery, making it feel hydrated and easy to detangle. But silicone is that it can build up on the hair, making it feel limp. Instead, we made a leave-in conditioner treatment from natural oils that won’t build up on the hair and actually hydrate hair instead of just making it feel nice for a while. Often we hear how lovely your conditioner smells. For this, we sourced use a phthalate-free scent so you can smell great without the scalp sensitivity. It’s also super popular with those with curly hair to help keep curls healthy, frizz-free and uder control.

MooGoo came to life 15 years ago. You know the story, right? Our founder noticed that his mother was using a white paste, intended for cows, to help with her Psoriasis. The cream kept skin on cow’s udders in good condition for milking. Although it seemed to be working well for his mum, the cream was thick, uncomfortable and hard to apply. Since his mum didn’t particularly like being lathered in a sticky cream made for cows, he took on the task of reformulating it and made up a lighter, non-greasy version more suitable for humans. Together they referred to it as “MooGoo” (goo for the cows) and the name stuck. Since then MooGoo has grown to over 50 products to help with lots of different skin and scalp problems and sold throughout the world. MooGoo’s ingredient philosophy has always remained the same: To make effective products using healthy ingredients, that we are comfortable using on ourselves and our loved ones.

This product is made with healthy and edible ingredients, and is dermatologically tested for it's gentleness. We use non-irritating ingredients in effective amounts to ensure the highest quality product for all ages and skin types, including those dealing with skin troubles and sensitivity. Not tested on animals. Made in Australia.

The passion flower is native to the Amazon and other tropical regions of North and South America. Many botanical species of passion flower exist. The passion flower has been used medicinally for hundreds of years, and its benefits are scientifically documented. It is most widely known for its sedative, anti-inflammatory, analgesic and anti-spasmodic properties.

Maracuja Oil is calming and sedating, and is suitable for inclusion in bath care products and products intended to promote relaxation. description:
Hold Onto Your Moisture

Conditioners are usually more gentle towards the scalp and hair because they normally don’t contain soaps. However, it can sometimes be troublesome fitting traditional humectants into a conditioner because they make things too watery. In this product, we bring back the HoneyQuat and the Saccharide Isomerate, because they’re such great performers. We also use jojoba oil, which is an almost perfect match for natural hair sebum so the application of the conditioner allows the jojoba oil to soak in very quickly and easily. Unlike most plant oils, jojoba oil doesn’t have an oily or greasy feel; it’s much more a silky/satiny type of feel.

An important part of our moisturizing approach to our conditioner is the inclusion of the cetyl stearate and isostearyl isostearate. These are normally very fatty/oily compounds, but like the jojoba oil, they feel completely non-oily / non-greasy to the touch. They are a type of organic compound named “esters”, and they can form extended structures in water called Liquid-Crystalline structures. These “liquid crystals” help to more effectively delivering water to the skin, and then the two stearate compounds soak into the skin and help replace/reinforce the skin’s natural lipid barrier. This cuts down on trans-epidermal water loss (TEWL), allowing the skin to hold onto more of its natural moisture.

Ingredient List:

Water (Aqua), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice*, Cetearyl Alcohol*, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Honey, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea Butter), Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Behentrimonium Methosulfate*, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil*, Kaolin Clay, Cetyl Alcohol*, Isostearyl Isostearate*, Potassium Cetyl Phosphate*, Cetyl Stearate*, Stearic Acid*, Saccharide Isomerate*, Caprylyl Glycol*, Essential Oil Blend*, Tetrasodium Glutamate Diacetate*, Phenoxyethanol.

description:
Conditioner Bars works great just as it arrives,as a hard bar. Good news,also works well as a soft bar.

CONDITIONER BAR USES:


  1. In-Shower Rinse:
    Wipe the bar directly onto the hair in a downward motion with the hair shaft. Let it set for a minute or two,then rinse. 
    2. In-Shower Soft Bar:
    The soft bar spreads on with much more ease. 
    3. Leave-In Conditioner: 
    Pick up the soft bar and with wet hands apply a nice coating of the conditioner onto your hands. Set the bar down. Wipe your hands all over your wet hair. Be generous. It will lock in moisture and help reduce frizzies. Repeat if necessary. Try it a few times applying different amounts until you find the right amount for your hair. 
    HOW TO SOFTEN THE BAR: 
  • Place one conditioner bar inside a lidded container.
  • Fill with 2 ounces water, let sit for 24 hours, flipping over half way through for each side of the bar to soak up water.
  • The bar will plump up in size and will be soft, like the texture of cream cheese.
  • The more water you use, the larger and softer the bar gets.
  • After the initial soak, you can easily adjust the water to bring the bar to a softness you like best.
  • Use a container that is wider than the bar to accommodate the increase in bar size and for you to be able to easily remove it once softened.


This bar will last you for months, even with regular use.

We are a premium multi-cultural healthy hair growth and retention company, and we attentively and thoroughly listen to the voices of our consumers to create a solution to their hair problems.
We built our company on the foundation of research and the "beauty, health, science" approach: enhance beauty and health with a scientific background.
We offer a comprehensive methodology to achieving beautiful, healthy hair, by infusing our hair care products with vitamins and essential nutrients such as Biotin, Vitamin A, B, C, D, & E and more.
We believe in maintaining an intimate relationship with our team, our customers, and the consumers.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection is a major key to maximizing moisture retention. Our advanced moisturizing blend is infused with essential vitamins and Moringa Oleifera Seed Oil, which is derived from The Moringa Tree, also known as the "healing" tree, that deeply penetrates the hair shaft to infuse it with vital moisture and nutrients. Power-packed to improve shine, strength, and manageability.

DIRECTIONS: After shampooing with Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo, apply a generous amount from roots to ends. Massage gently into the hair, especially the ends, and distribute evenly. Cover hair with a plastic cap and sit under the dryer for 15 minutes, or leave in up to 1 hour without heat. Rinse thoroughly with cool water. Style as usual. Use every 1-2 weeks for best results.



¿Quién es la elección de la melena?

Somos una empresa de crecimiento y retención de cabello saludable multicultural premium, y escuchamos atenta y minuciosamente las voces de nuestros consumidores para crear una solución a sus problemas de cabello.
Construimos nuestra empresa sobre la base de la investigación y el enfoque "belleza, salud, ciencia": mejorar la belleza y la salud con un fondo científico.
Ofrecemos una metodología integral para lograr un cabello hermoso y saludable, infundiendo nuestros productos de cuidado del cabello con vitaminas y nutrientes esenciales como Biotina, Vitamina A, B, C, D y E y más.
Creemos en mantener una relación íntima con nuestro equipo, nuestros clientes y los consumidores.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection es una clave importante para maximizar la retención de humedad. Nuestra mezcla hidratante avanzada está infundida con vitaminas esenciales y aceite de semilla de Moringa Oleifera, que se deriva del árbol de Moringa, también conocido como el árbol de "curación", que penetra profundamente en el tallo del cabello para infundirlo con humedad vital y nutrientes. Potencia para mejorar el brillo, la fuerza y la manejabilidad.

DIRECCIONES: Después del champú con Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo, aplique una cantidad generosa de raíces a extremos. Masajee suavemente en el cabello, especialmente en los extremos, y distribuya uniformemente. Cubra el cabello con una tapa de plástico y siéntese debajo de la secadora durante 15 minutos, o déjelo en hasta 1 hora sin calor. Enjuague bien con agua fría. Estilo como de costumbre. Use cada 1-2 semanas para obtener los mejores resultados.



מי זו הבחירה הרעמה?

אנחנו חברת צמיחת שיער ושימור פרימיום בריאה, רב-תרבותית ואנו מקשיבים בתשומת לב וביסודיות לקולות של הצרכנים שלנו כדי ליצור פתרון לבעיות השיער שלהם.
בנינו את החברה שלנו על בסיס המחקר ואת הגישה "יופי, בריאות, מדע": לשפר יופי ובריאות עם רקע מדעי.
אנו מציעים מתודולוגיה מקיפה להשגת שיער יפה ובריא, על ידי החדרת מוצרי טיפוח השיער שלנו עם ויטמינים וחומרים מזינים חיוניים כגון ביוטין, ויטמין A, B, C, D & E ועוד.
אנו מאמינים בשמירה על מערכת יחסים אינטימית עם הצוות שלנו, הלקוחות שלנו והצרכנים.

קולקציית הלחות האינסופית של שמן מתוק ודבש של Moringa היא המפתח העיקרי למיקסום שמירת הלחות. תערובת הלחות המתקדמת שלנו כוללת ויטמינים חיוניים ושמן זרעי Moringa Oleifera שמקורם בעץ המורינגה, הידוע גם בשם עץ "ריפוי", אשר חודר עמוק לתוך מוט השיער כדי להחדיר אותו עם לחות וחומרים מזינים חיוניים. ארוז בחשמל כדי לשפר ברק, חוזק ויכולת הניהול.

הוראות: לאחר החפיפה עם שמן מתוק ומורינגה טרופית ושמפו לחות אינסופי, מרחו כמות נדיבה מהשורשים לקצוות. עסו בעדינות לתוך השיער, במיוחד את הקצוות, והפצו באופן שווה. כסו את השיער עם מכסה פלסטיק וישבו מתחת למייבש במשך 15 דקות, או השאירו עד שעה אחת ללא חום. שטפו ביסודיות במים קרים. סגנון כרגיל. השתמשו כל 1-2 שבועות לקבלת התוצאות הטובות ביותר.



Wer ist die richtige Mähne?

Wir sind ein erstklassiges multikulturelles gesundes Haarwachstum und Retention Unternehmen, und wir hören aufmerksam und gründlich auf die Stimmen unserer Verbraucher, um eine Lösung für ihre Haarprobleme zu schaffen.
Wir bauten unser Unternehmen auf der Grundlage der Forschung und dem Ansatz "Schönheit, Gesundheit, Wissenschaften" auf: Verbesserung der Schönheit und Gesundheit mit einem wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund.
Wir bieten eine umfassende Methodologie, um schönes, gesundes Haar zu erreichen, indem wir unsere Haarpflegeprodukte mit Vitaminen und essentiellen Nährstoffen wie Biotin, Vitamin A, B, C, D, & E und mehr infundieren.
Wir glauben daran, eine intime Beziehung zu unserem Team, unseren Kunden und den Verbrauchern aufrechtzuerhalten.

Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Collection ist ein wichtiger Schlüssel zur Maximierung der Feuchtigkeitsspeicherung. Unsere fortschrittliche feuchtigkeitsspendende Mischung ist mit essentiellen Vitaminen und Moringa Oleifera Samenöl angereichert, das aus dem Moringa-Baum gewonnen wird, auch bekannt als "heilenden" Baum, das tief in den Haarschaft eindringt, um es mit lebenswichtigen Feuchtigkeit und Nährstoffen zu versorgen. Power-packed to improve shine, strength and manageability.

Anwendung: Nach dem Shampoonieren mit Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture Shampoo eine großzügige Menge vom Ansatz bis zu den Spitzen auftragen. Sanft ins Haar einmassieren, insbesondere in die Spitzen, und gleichmäßig verteilen. Bedecken Sie das Haar mit einer Kunststoffkappe und legen Sie es für 15 Minuten unter den Trockner, oder lassen Sie es bis zu 1 Stunde ohne Hitze einwirken. Mit kaltem Wasser gründlich ausspülen. Wie gewohnt stylen. Für beste Ergebnisse alle 1-2 Wochen verwenden.



من هي مان تشويس؟

نحن شركة فاخرة متعددة الثقافات لنمو الشعر والحفاظ عليه، ونحن نستمع بعناية ودقة إلى أصوات المستهلكين لخلق حل لمشكلات الشعر.
لقد بنينا شركتنا على أساس البحث ونهج "الجمال والصحة والعلم": تعزيز الجمال والصحة بخلفية علمية.
نقدم منهجية شاملة للحصول على شعر جميل وصحي من خلال غمر منتجات العناية بالشعر الخاصة بنا بالفيتامينات والمغذيات الأساسية مثل البيوتين وفيتامين أ وب وسي ودي واي وغيرها.
نحن نؤمن بالحفاظ على علاقة ودية مع فريقنا وعملائنا ومستهلكين.

مجموعة الترطيب تروبيكال مورينجا من الزيوت الحلوة والعسل هي مفتاح رئيسي لزيادة الاحتفاظ بالرطوبة. مزيج الترطيب المتطور الخاص بنا غني بالفيتامينات الأساسية وزيت بذور المورينغا أوليفيرا، المشتق من شجرة المورينجا، المعروفة أيضًا باسم شجرة "الشفاء"، التي تتغلغل بعمق في ساق الشعر لتغمرها بالرطوبة والمغذيات الحيوية. معبأة بالطاقة لتحسين اللمعان والقوة وسهولة التصفيف.

الإرشادات: بعد غسل الشعر بالشامبو بزيت المورينغا الحلو والعسل المرطب من تروبيكال مورينغا ضعي كمية وفيرة من الجذور حتى الأطراف. دلكيه بلطف على الشعر، خاصة الأطراف، ووزعيه بالتساوي. قومي بتغطية الشعر بغطاء بلاستيكي واتركيه تحت المجفف لمدة 15 دقيقة، أو اتركيه لمدة تصل إلى ساعة واحدة بدون حرارة. يشطف بالكامل بالماء البارد. صففي شعرك كالمعتاد. استخدميه كل أسبوع إلى أسبوعين للحصول على أفضل النتائج.



Quem é a escolha da crina?

Somos uma empresa de crescimento e retenção de cabelo saudável multicultural premium, e ouvimos com atenção e atenção as vozes de nossos consumidores para criar uma solução para seus problemas de cabelo.
Construímos nossa empresa com base na pesquisa e na abordagem de "beleza, saúde, ciência": melhorar a beleza e a saúde com uma experiência científica.
Oferecemos uma metodologia abrangente para atingir cabelos bonitos e saudáveis, infundindo nossos produtos de cuidados com o cabelo com vitaminas e nutrientes essenciais como biotina, vitamina A, B, C, D, E e mais.
Acreditamos em manter um relacionamento íntimo com nossa equipe, nossos clientes e os consumidores.

A coleção Tropical Moringa Sweet Oil & Honey Endless Moisture é uma importante chave para maximizar a retenção de umidade. Nossa avançada mistura hidratante é infundida com vitaminas essenciais e óleo de semente de Moringa Oleifera, que é derivado da Moringa Tree, também conhecida como a árvore de "cura", que penetra profundamente no eixo capilar para infundir umidade e nutrientes vitais. Equipada para melhorar o brilho, força e manuseio.

INSTRUÇÕES: Após lavar o xampu com óleo doce de moringa tropical e mel Endless Moisture, aplique uma quantidade generosa das raízes às pontas. Massageie suavemente no cabelo, especialmente nas pontas e distribua uniformemente. Cubra o cabelo com uma tampa de plástico e sente-se sob a secadora por 15 minutos, ou deixe em até 1 hora sem calor. Enxágue completamente com água fria. Estilo como de costume. Use a cada 1-2 semanas para melhores resultados.



Mane 的选择是谁?

我们是一家优质的多文化健康的头发生长和保留公司,我们精心彻底倾听消费者的声音,创造解决头发问题的解决方案。
我们建立在研究的基础上,"美容、健康、科学"方法的基础上:用科学背景来增强美容和健康。
我们为头发护理产品注入维生素和必需营养素,如生物素、维生素 A、B、C、D 和 E 等,提供一种全面的方法来实现美丽健康的头发。
我们坚信与团队、客户和消费者保持亲密关系。

热带辣木甜油和蜂蜜无尽保湿系列是最大限度地保持水分的主要关键。 我们的高级保湿混合物注入了必需的维生素和辣木籽油,这种油来自辣木,也称为"治愈"树,深入渗透发干,为其注入重要的水分和营养素。 力量包装以提高光泽、强度和易打理性。

说明:使用热带辣木甜油和蜂蜜无尽保湿洗发水,洗发后,从根部到发梢涂抹大量。 轻轻按摩头发,尤其是发梢,均匀分布。 用塑料帽盖住头发,放在烘干机下 15 分钟,或保持长达 1 小时不加热。 用冷水彻底冲洗。 像平常一样风格。 每 1-2 周使用一次,以获得最佳效果。



誰是鬃毛的選擇?

我們是一家優質的多文化健康頭髮生長和保留公司,我們認真徹底地聆聽消費者的聲音,以創造解決頭髮問題的解決方案。
我們公司建立在研究的基礎上,並以「美容、健康、科學」方法:以科學背景增強美與健康。
我們提供全方位方法,透過將頭髮護理產品注入生物素、維他命 A、B、C、D 和 E 等必需營養素,實現美麗健康的頭髮。
我們相信與我們的團隊、顧客和消費者保持親密關係。 ​

Tropical Moringa 甜油和蜂蜜無盡的保濕系列是最大限度地提高保濕效果的主要關鍵。 我們先進的保濕混合物注入基本維生素和辣木Oleifera 籽油,其來源於辣木樹,也稱為「癒合」樹,深層穿透頭髮軸,注入重要的水分和營養。 強力包裝,改善光澤、強度和易整理性。

使用說明:使用 Tropical Moringa 甜油和蜂蜜無盡的保濕洗髮精進行洗髮後,塗抹大量從根部到末端。 輕輕按摩頭髮,尤其是末端,均勻分佈。 用塑料蓋蓋住頭髮,在烘乾機下坐著 15 分鐘,或靜置 1 小時,不加熱。 用冷水徹底沖洗。 一如既往的風格。 每 1-2 週使用一次以獲得最佳效果。



갈기 선택은 누구입니까?

저희는 프리미엄 다문화적인 건강한 모발 성장 및 유지 회사로, 모발 문제에 대한 해결책을 만들기 위해 소비자의 목소리를 세심하고 철저하게 경청합니다.
저희는 연구의 기초와 "아름다움, 건강, 과학" 접근 방식을 바탕으로 회사를 구축했습니다. 과학적인 배경으로 아름다움과 건강을 향상시킵니다.
저희는 헤어 케어 제품에 비오틴, 비타민 A, B, C, D, E 등과 같은 필수 영양소를 주입하여 아름답고 건강한 모발을 달성하는 종합적인 방법을 제공합니다.
저희는 팀, 고객 및 소비자와의 친밀한 관계를 유지하는 것을 믿습니다.

트로피컬 모링가 스위트 오일 & 허니 엔드리스 모이스처 컬렉션은 수분 보존을 극대화하는 주요 열쇠입니다. 당사의 고급 보습 블렌드는 필수 비타민과 모링가 올레페라 씨드 오일이 함유되어 있습니다. 모링가 나무에서 추출한 모링가 올레페라 씨드 오일은 모낭에 깊이 침투하여 중요한 수분과 영양소를 주입합니다. 광택, 강도 및 관리 편의성을 향상시키기 위해 전원 포장.

사용 방법: 트로피컬 모링가 스위트 오일 & 허니 엔드리스 모이스처 샴푸로 샴푸한 후 뿌리부터 끝까지 충분한 양을 바르세요. 머리카락, 특히 끝 부분에 부드럽게 마사지하고 고르게 분배합니다. 플라스틱 캡으로 머리카락을 덮고 건조기 아래에 15분간 두거나 열을 가하지 않고 최대 1시간 동안 방치하십시오. 찬물로 완전히 헹구십시오. 평소와 같은 스타일. 최상의 결과를 위해 1-2주마다 사용하세요.
